evidence: STATE_TRANSITIONS defines the allowed order state transitions. This is a business rule and belongs in the domain layer.
The Order constructor enforces the invariant 'Order must contain at least one item', which is domain logic.
Order.transitionTo checks transitions and cancellation rules, which is domain behaviour.
The OrderItem constructor checks that quantity is positive, which is a value-object invariant.
The file has no repository, HTTP, database, framework or DTO-mapping code.
